name: Community Free Clinic — July Session
summary: Free health check-ups for seniors: blood pressure, blood sugar, ECG and doctor consultations.
description: Our volunteer doctors and nurses provide essential health screenings for adults aged 60 and over. Services include blood pressure and blood sugar measurement, ECG, and one-on-one consultations. Please bring your ID and any recent medical records. Family members are welcome to accompany you.

name: Happy Knocking — In-Home Wellness Visit
summary: A trained volunteer visits you at home for companionship, a wellbeing check and help with light tasks.
description: Modelled on the 'Happy Knocking' initiative, this programme matches volunteers with seniors who live alone. Each visit lasts about one hour and can include conversation, reading together, a basic wellbeing check, or help with simple household tasks.
location: North Melbourne Community Hub, Melbourne VIC

name: Cardio-Cerebral Health Workshop
summary: A guided workshop on preventing and managing hypertension, stroke risk and heart health in later life.
description: Led by our health education team, this workshop covers practical guidance on chronic disease management: recognising early warning signs of stroke, daily blood pressure habits, diet and safe exercise for older adults. Printed take-home guides are provided in large print.

name: Joyful Age Companionship — Volunteer Shift
summary: Join our volunteer team for a companionship shift at the senior activity centre.
description: Volunteers support group activities at the senior activity centre: board games, gentle exercise sessions and tea time. Full training is provided before your first shift. This programme is open to registered volunteers only.
